title: Grade 2 French — Wed, May 27
description: La famille — Day 3 of 5: Describing family members
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'My father is tall.' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mon père est grand.' Father is masculine → mon père. Grand (not grande) for masculine.

questions.question: How do you say 'My mother is kind.' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Ma mère est gentille.' Mother (mère) is feminine → ma, gentille (feminine form of gentil).

questions.question: What is the feminine form of 'grand' (tall/big)?
questions.explanation: 'Grande' is the feminine form. Mon père est grand. / Ma mère est grande. Add -e for feminine.

questions.question: How do you say 'My sister is small.' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Ma sœur est petite.' Sœur is feminine → ma, petite (feminine form of petit).

questions.question: Fill in: 'Mon frère est ___.' (intelligent — same word in both genders?)
questions.explanation: 'Mon frère est intelligent.' Frère is masculine → intelligent (without e). Intelligente = feminine.

questions.question: How do you say 'My grandmother is old.'?
questions.explanation: 'Ma grand-mère est vieille.' Vieux (masc) → vieille (fem). Grand-mère is feminine.

questions.question: Translate: 'My brother is funny.'
questions.explanation: 'Mon frère est drôle.' Drôle means funny/amusing — it's the same for masculine and feminine!

questions.question: How do you say 'young' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Jeune' = Young. 'Ma cousine est jeune.' (Note: jeune is the same for masculine and feminine.)

questions.question: Translate: 'I have a big family.'
questions.explanation: 'J'ai une grande famille.' Grande comes BEFORE famille as an exception (BAGS adjective: Beauty, Age, Goodness, Size go before the noun).

questions.question: How do you say 'My parents are nice.'?
questions.explanation: 'Mes parents sont gentils.' Plural → sont (not est). Gentils (masc. plural form).

questions.question: Translate: 'My uncle is funny and kind.'
options: Mon oncle est drôle et gentil.
Ma oncle est drôle et gentil.
Mon oncle est drôle et gentille.
Mon oncle sont drôle et gentil.
questions.explanation: 'Mon oncle est drôle et gentil.' Oncle is masculine → mon, gentil (not gentille).

questions.question: How do you say 'My sister is tall and intelligent.'?
options: Ma sœur est grand et intelligent.
Ma sœur est grande et intelligent.
Ma sœur est grande et intelligente.
Mon sœur est grande et intelligente.
questions.explanation: 'Ma sœur est grande et intelligente.' Both adjectives get the feminine -e ending because sœur is feminine.

questions.question: Complete: 'Ma famille est ___.' (happy)
questions.explanation: La famille can be described as 'heureuse' (feminine) since famille is feminine. But in casual speech both forms appear. Famille est heureuse is most correct grammatically.
